message.better_advancements.no_server_su: Server does not support advancement editing. Changes are visual only.
config.better_advancements.title: Better Advancements Configuration
config.better_advancements.doFade.toolti: Darkens the background behind advancements when hovering over an entry.
config.better_advancements.criteriaDetai: How to show criteria requirements on hover. Default: Shows obtained. Spoiler: Shows unobtained. All: Shows both.
config.better_advancements.requiresShift: Require holding Shift to see criteria details.
config.better_advancements.addToInventor: Add a button to open advancements from the player inventory.
config.better_advancements.showDebugCoor: Shows internal GUI coordinates, useful for modpack makers aligning advancements.
config.better_advancements.orderTabsAlph: Sorts the top advancement tabs alphabetically.
config.better_advancements.uiScaling.too: Scales the entire Better Advancements UI. Values below 50% might give odd results.
config.better_advancements.onlyUseAboveA: Restricts tabs to only the top edge instead of wrapping around the screen.
config.better_advancements.enableEditMod: Right click advancements to edit their properties and rearrange them (Requires OP to sync).
config.better_advancements.drawArrows.to: Draws directional arrows on advancement lines.
config.better_advancements.drawDirectLin: Draws direct straight/angled lines between advancements instead of the vanilla orthogonal lines.
config.better_advancements.hideLines.too: Hides all connection lines between advancements.
config.better_advancements.defaultComple: Color of the connection line when an advancement is completed.
config.better_advancements.defaultUncomp: Color of the connection line when an advancement is locked/uncompleted.
config.better_advancements.defaultComple: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is completed.
config.better_advancements.defaultUncomp: Color of the outer icon frame when an advancement is locked.
config.better_advancements.defaultComple: Color of the title banner when an advancement is completed.
config.better_advancements.defaultUncomp: Color of the title banner when an advancement is locked.
